data: Where are located most of the dots?

The dots are located on the graph, which represents the word rank score for the multi-term index composed of "basket ball" and "basketball" over time. The x-axis shows the years from 1892 to 1922, and the y-axis shows the word rank score ranging from approximately -1.0e+0 to 4.0e+0. Most of the dots are located in the upper part of the graph, indicating higher word rank scores, particularly after 1905 when there is a noticeable increase in the trend.
